You are an expert in the field of chemistry and now have a ClinTox prediction task. 
The ClinTox (Clinical Toxicity) prediction task aims to predict the toxicity problems that compounds may cause in clinical trials, thereby avoiding potential drug development failures and ensuring patient safety. Specific mission questions are as follows:
CCCCCCCCC[NH+]1C[C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]1CO)O)O)O
You have to output your guess, which is "Yes" or "No", and exactly follow the output format, which is as follows:
{"answer": "The answer you judge"}. I don't need any explanation, you just need to output your judgment in the format.

Please use your tools to analyze and solve this problem accurately.

Plan:
1. [ ] Identify the compound represented by the SMILES and retrieve relevant toxicity/development evidence.
2. [ ] Use that evidence to judge the ClinTox label and return the requested JSON.

Tool call: go_search_agent
Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 3, 'search_target': 'Identify the compound represented by SMILES CCCCCCCCC[NH+]1C[C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]1CO)O)O)O (likely N-nonyl-deoxynojirimycin or related iminosugar), and find reliable evidence on clinical toxicity, drug trial toxicity/approval, and whether it has toxicity concerns that would support a ClinTox positive label.'}

1. [✗] Identify the compound and retrieve clinical-toxicity evidence (the first search returned no usable findings).
2. [ ] Make a focused follow-up search for the exact structure/name and clinical evidence.
3. [ ] Use the evidence to judge the ClinTox label and return the requested JSON.

Tool call: go_search_agent
Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 2, 'search_target': 'Exact-structure chemistry lookup and clinical status: SMILES CCCCCCCCC[NH+]1C[C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]1CO)O)O)O. Identify its neutral compound name (N-nonyl-DNJ / N-nonyldeoxynojirimycin or alternative), then determine whether there is reported human clinical-trial toxicity or a clinical development failure due to toxicity. Return specific evidence and citations/IDs; distinguish absence of evidence from demonstrated safety.'}

1. [✓] Identify the compound and retrieve clinical-toxicity evidence (two delegated searches were attempted but returned no usable findings).
2. [ ] Use a direct structure/name lookup and chemical reasoning to assess clinical toxicity.
3. [ ] Return the required JSON label only.

Tool call: code_execution
Tool call input: {'code': 'import requests
s='CCCCCCCCC[NH+]1C[C@@H]([C@H]([C@@H]([C@H]1CO)O)O)O'
urls=[f'https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/smiles/{requests.utils.quote(s,safe="")}/property/Title,IUPACName,IsomericSMILES,InChIKey/JSON',f'https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/smiles/{requests.utils.quote(s,safe="")}/synonyms/JSON']
for u in urls:
    try:
        r=requests.get(u,timeout=15)
        print(r.status_code, r.text[:2000])
    except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__,e)', 'language': 'python'}
